title.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
title.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

summary.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
summary.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

assumptions.ja: 対称問題では実対称行列、非対称問題では既知の分離した最大固有値5を持つ実行列を使います。初期ベクトルは固定seedです。非対称Ritz値は複素数を許し、最大実部で選びます。
assumptions.en: The symmetric case is real symmetric; the nonsymmetric case is real with a known separated largest eigenvalue 5. Starting vectors use fixed seeds. Nonsymmetric Ritz values may be complex and are selected by largest real part.

algorithm.ja: Lanczosの3項漸化式に2回の全再直交化を加え、Arnoldiは修正Gram–Schmidtを2回行います。小さな射影行列T/HだけをNumPyのeigh/eigで解き、元空間へRitzベクトルを戻します。大きな元行列の密固有値計算は参照側だけで使います。
algorithm.en: Lanczos uses its three-term recurrence plus two passes of full reorthogonalization; Arnoldi uses two-pass modified Gram–Schmidt. Only the small projected T/H is solved by NumPy eigh/eig before lifting Ritz vectors. A full dense solve of the original matrix is used only on the reference side.

validation.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
validation.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

limits.ja: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。

validation.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. title.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布
title.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component

summary.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子のランダム二体衝突で、保存則と平衡分布への緩和を検証します。
summary.en: Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules.

assumptions.ja: 等質・等質量・等方散乱・一定衝突率。各roundで全粒子を一度ずつランダムに組み合わせます。初期は±sqrt(3)の二つのビームで、温度の目標は1です。 各seedは総運動量0・総エネルギー固定のmicrocanonical系で、Maxwell/Gammaは大粒子数極限の参照です。
assumptions.en: Homogeneous, equal masses, isotropic scattering and constant collision rate. Each round randomly matches every particle once. Two initial beams at ±sqrt(3) give target temperature one. Each seed has zero total momentum and fixed total energy: its finite-N equilibrium is microcanonical, while Maxwell/Gamma are large-N references.

algorithm.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
algorithm.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

validation.ja: 粒子512・2048・8192、16 seedで、運動量・運動エネルギー、Maxwellの2次/4次モーメント、Gamma(3/2,1)のエネルギーCDFを比較。異方性の期待減衰率(N−2)/(2(N−1))も独立に照合します。 有限Nの成分4次モーメントは3−6/(3N−1)であり、Maxwell値3との有限N偏りとseed間の標本誤差を区別します。
validation.en: Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty.

limits.ja: DSMCの衝突部分の教育例です。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存の衝突選択、実際の輸送係数・流れ場・全seedでの保証は含みません。Bird原著の剛体球条件を再現したとは主張しません。
limits.en: This is an educational DSMC collision component. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection, measured transport coefficients/flow fields or every-seed guarantee. Bird’s original hard-sphere conditions are not reproduced.

summary.ja: 核配置ごとに電子基底状態を収束させ、得られた力で核の古典運動を進める。
summary.en: Converge the electronic ground state at each nuclear configuration and propagate classical nuclei with its forces.

references.label: M. Born and R. Oppenheimer (1927), Zur Quantentheorie der Molekeln
references.scope: Publisher bibliography and DOI checked. Cited for the historical basis of Born–Oppenheimer separation, without claiming a full-text audit or reproduction of a modern MD implementation.

references.label: R. Car and M. Parrinello (1985), Unified Approach for Molecular Dynamics and Density-Functional Theory
references.scope: Publisher bibliography/abstract and original equations (3)–(5) and discussion of fictitious electronic motion near the BO surface consulted. The paper’s silicon dynamics have not been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Classical nuclei and a selected adiabatic electronic ground state. A fixed-He₂ force-provider/local-Verlet check exists, while full trajectories remain unvalidated.
The published interface fixes the periodic cell, occupations and electronic model, and reconverges SCF at every visited geometry.
assumptions_ja: 核は古典力学、電子は選択した断熱的基底状態。固定He₂の力供給と局所Verlet確認があるが、軌道全体は未検証。
公開接続例は周期セル・占有・電子モデルを固定し、訪れた各核配置でSCFを解き直す。
methods.units: Atomic units: energies hartree, forces hartree/bohr, positions bohr, time atomic units and explicit nuclear masses in electron masses.
methods.units_ja: 原子単位：エネルギー hartree、力 hartree/bohr、座標 bohr、時間 原子時間、核質量 電子質量。
methods.boundary_conditions: Choose isolated or periodic boundaries for the model; the published local interface uses the fixed periodic He₂ cell.
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: モデルに応じて孤立・周期境界を選ぶ。公開した局所接続例は固定した周期He₂セル。

next_deliverable.ja: 独立参照と照合した力を使い、長時間NVEドリフトと時間刻み・SCF公差への軌道の感度を系統的に測る。
next_deliverable.en: Use independently checked forces to measure long-time NVE drift and systematic trajectory sensitivity to timestep and SCF tolerance.

limitations.ja: BOMD全体の状態は解説のみ。別の力配布版で行った短いVerlet接続確認を、長時間軌道・温度制御の検証として数えません。
limitations.en: Overall BOMD remains reading only. The separate force release’s short Verlet interface check does not validate long trajectories or thermostats.

title.ja: 収録方針
title.en: Editorial scope

statement.ja: 数値計算の数理的な手法・定式化・適用条件・検証を中心に扱います。AMR（適応格子細分化）、並列化、mixed precision（混合精度）などの計算効率化・実装上の技巧は、独立した収録・開発の対象から外します。通常の丸め誤差や数値安定性は基礎として扱います。
statement.en: The focus is mathematical methods, formulations, applicability and verification. AMR (adaptive mesh refinement), parallelization and mixed-precision techniques for computational efficiency are outside the scope of dedicated coverage and development. Ordinary roundoff and numerical stability remain foundational topics.

scope.ja: 主要24手法の問題設定・採用変種・使う条件・避ける条件・単位・境界条件・制約と一次文献を個別に整理。文献・コードの確認であり、新しい数値検証を意味しません。
scope.en: Method-specific problems, adopted variants, use/avoid conditions, units, boundaries, limitations and primary sources for 24 priority methods. Source/code inspection is separate from new numerical validation.
